required_outcomes: Reads the landlord's email of today 15:21, which the phone line did not use: Dawson is off sick and the landlord asks the agency to use its contractor after all, up to £250. Records this as his current decision (approved, £250 cap), replacing the 8 April own-contractor decision.
Tells Oscar the job is his again, correcting what the phone line told him, before his Thursday lunchtime deadline, and books the slot he committed to: Friday 12 April 09:00-12:00 at Flat 24.
Gives the tenant Eliza Jenkins written notice of the Friday visit by Oscar (more than 24 hours ahead), explaining that Dawson is no longer coming.
acceptable_alternatives: Confirming the Friday slot with Oscar first and booking it once he replies, if that is done now and a follow-up is set before Thursday lunchtime.
positive_behaviours: Tells the landlord that Oscar is booked for Friday 12 April 09:00-12:00 within his £250 limit.
Clears the 'Waiting for Landlord' hold now that the landlord has answered.
Asks the tenant to say whether Dawson came at all this week, so two people do not end up working on the window.
red_flags: Acts on the 8 April decision and leaves Oscar stood down.
Asks the landlord to confirm again what his email already says.
prohibited_actions: Escalating a routine re-booking to a human.
critical_failures: Leaves the job on hold for Dawson, so nobody is booked, despite the landlord's latest email.
